name: generate-financial-dummy-data
description: Create test grants through a conversation. Receive verified records or an import file.

interface.shortDescription: Create test grants through a short conversation.
interface.longDescription: The plugin asks up to three questions at a time. It waits for your answers. It then creates test grants in your chosen application or prepares an import file. This version covers grants and required supporting records.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $generate-financial-dummy-data to create test grants. Start by asking up to three questions about the missing details. Wait for my answers before creating anything.
